label: Health facilities (hospital / PHCC / PHCU)
source: WHO / MoH Master Facility List, April 2025 (HDX)
notes: Point per facility with type; functionality not reported. Some listed facilities lack coordinates (counted in county totals only).

label: UNMISS peacekeeping deployments
source: Geo-PKO v2.3 (2018-2024) + UN Geospatial map 4456 Rev.62/67 (Jan 2025, Jan 2026)
notes: One point per location per year (field `year`), with type (HQ / team site), estimated troops and contributing countries/units. 2026 locations from Jan 2026 map (Aweil, Tambura, Yei, Torit closed).

label: Oil fields and wells
source: Global Energy Monitor GOGET (CC-BY 4.0) + OpenStreetMap wells (ODbL)
notes: type = 'oil field (extraction area)' (GEM, with operator/production) or 'oil well' (OSM). Static.

label: Oil pipelines (lines)
notes: Line layer docs/data/lines_pipelines.geojson; includes proposed GEM routes (status field).

label: Schools
source: SSSAMS 2015 (HDX, CC0) + OpenStreetMap education facilities (HOT/HDX, ODbL)
notes: SSSAMS points carry type and 2015 enrolment by sex (year=2015); OSM points year=2026. The two sources overlap (duplicates possible).

label: PoC sites, IDP & refugee camps, humanitarian hubs
source: Curated: OSM (HOT/HDX) coordinates; UNMISS/UNHCR/IOM public site lists; WFP Logistics Cluster CONOPS (Jun 2026)
notes: Static layer with `status` describing active period. `coord_quality` flags approximate positions. Not exhaustive: IOM DTM lists hundreds of smaller displacement sites (handled in the DTM layer).

label: UCDP GED conflict events (2018-2025)
notes: Organized-violence events with >=1 death. type: state_based / non_state / one_sided; deaths = best estimate; where_prec 1=exact .. 3=county, >=4 coarse (admin-1/country). oil_related = keyword match on oil fields/pipelines (1 inside SSD; 5 cross-border oil events e.g. Heglig added with inside_ssd=false).

label: WFP monitored markets
notes: Markets with retail price monitoring; first_price/last_price = months with data 2018-2025.

label: IOM Flow Monitoring points
source: IOM DTM South Sudan Flow Monitoring Registry (team unified dataset)
notes: Where FMR counts travellers; FMR numbers depend on these locations
